nodes.text:
NOT INTERNATIONAL CONCERN: The increase in cases of respiratory infections in China due to the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) currently does not constitute a public health emergency of international concern, the Ministry of Health and Social Services has said.

(NAMPA) https://t.co/4OjTvM1KWe

nodes.author: nampapress
nodes.text: The ministry in a statement on Wednesday said Namibia is monitoring the outbreak and explained that HMPV is a common respiratory virus that circulates in many countries, across winter and spring.
